intro: Run the analysis commands on this experiment's sealed runs. Each button starts a background job with a live log; the views below refresh when it ends.

check.title: Re-check verdict
check.description: Analyze the sealed runs again and save a new verdict, with the release policy the experiment froze.

codescan.title: Code scan
codescan.description: Security findings on the lines each run's agent added, with the experiment's veto level.

awareness.title: Eval awareness
awareness.description: Heuristic scan of the agents' own words for remarks that they are being tested. Report only, never a gate.

blame.title: Blame
blame.description: Which agent of each multi-agent run caused its failure (tier 1, from the sealed gates). Replays stay a CLI step.

clusters.title: Failure clusters
clusters.description: Refresh the run index and group failed runs across experiments by cause.

index.title: Results index
index.description: Rebuild the derived index behind trends, search and the leaderboard. Verdicts never read it.

result.codescan: {{findings}} counted findings over {{scanned}} of {{runs}} runs; {{vetoed}} would be vetoed
result.blame: {{runs}} runs: {{failed}} failed, {{blamed}} pinned on one agent

views.verdictNone: No verdict yet. Run a check once the experiment has sealed runs.
views.awarenessNone: No awareness report yet. Start a scan above.
views.awarenessArm: Arm {{arm}}: {{withSignals}} of {{scanned}} scanned runs with signals ({{signals}} signals)
views.clustersNone: No failure clusters for this experiment.

links.title: Cost
links.costExplain: Why one arm cost more (cost explain)

audit.title: Audit a published table
audit.description: Upload a per-task CSV with columns task,a_pass,a_n,b_pass,b_n (for example a paper's results) to get the same paired verdict.
audit.empty: Choose a CSV file or paste a table first.
audit.tooLarge: The table is larger than 1 MiB. Trim it or run `bifrost-bench audit` locally.
